name: Natural Edge Furniture
old_description: Natural Edge Furniture crafts timeless, custom furniture from premium wood slabs salvaged responsibly from the Pacific Northwest. Our expert craftsmen help you with design and make recommendations on wood species to help your vision become reality. We specialize in large dining and conference tables, desks, occasional tables and benches.
about:
Natural Edge Furniture operates from the Maker's District in Bend, Oregon, where it crafts custom furniture from premium wood slabs salvaged responsibly from the Pacific Northwest. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The shop specializes in large dining and conference tables, desks, occasional tables, benches, chairs, and stools, all built to order with expert design assistance and wood-species recommendations. It also maintains a sizable inventory of live-edge slabs for sale to other makers. Processes include milling, finishing, bookmatching, inlay work, fuming, and waterfall-edge construction.

Customers range from residential clients seeking statement pieces to commercial buyers outfitting conference rooms; the product catalog shows walnut, blue pine, African sapele, white oak, madrone, hickory, elm, and fumed white oak among the species used.

The company states that it continually seeks to reduce its carbon footprint through energy-efficient operations, waste minimization, sourcing from green suppliers, and ongoing recycling and donation programs.
